scenarios.name: generate-comments-crud
scenarios.rationale: Response A provides more of the required files and details, but still lacks the zero‑argument list_comments/0 function and test suite; Response B is even more incomplete.

scenarios.name: add-article-publish-api
scenarios.rationale: Response A is in Node.js and does not meet the Elixir-specific rubric, while Response B implements the required Elixir controller action but does not call Articles.update_article/2 as specified.

scenarios.name: create-chat-channel
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers the required Phoenix socket and channel logic (token verification, user_id assignment, join/3 implementation) but uses a "room:*" topic instead of the specified "chat:*"; Response B is a Node.js implementation and does not meet the Phoenix‑specific rubric.
